data.name: Clarabelle
data.gender_notes: Clarabelle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Clarabelle is derived from the Old English words 'clar' meaning clear or bright and 'bell' meaning beautiful. This name was popularized in the English-speaking world in the Middle Ages and has been used ever since. The name Clarabelle carries the meaning “Bright, clear, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Clarabelle usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, clear, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and clarity in the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Clarabelle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, clear, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Clarabelle total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
